newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson Multimedia H1 loss 3 bln Ffr-paper.
newsitem.headline: Thomson Multimedia H1 loss 3 bln Ffr-paper.

text.p: Thomson Multimedia, the consumer electronics company wholly-owned by soon-to-be-privatised Thomson SA, recorded a loss of three billion francs for the 1996 first half, newspaper Le Monde reported on Friday.
It said the loss included a 1.2 billion franc provision aimed at cleaning up the books ahead of the group's sale. Bidders are expected to confirm their offers by September 15.
Le Monde said Thomson had a first-half operating loss of one billion francs and a two percent drop in sales, reflecting a tough environment for the electronics industry.
Financial expenses totalling 800 million francs in the first half on the group's 14 billion franc debt weighed on the results, the newspaper said.
Alcatel Alsthom and Lagardere are expected to submit offers for Thomson, with Lagardere having said it planned to sell Thomson Multimedia and retain defence arm Thomson-CSF.
